# What the extension is made of, as opposed to what the repository holds.
# Both the local install and the packed zip are built from this list, so
# there is one place to add a file to and no way to add it to only one of
# them. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# Generated files are not here: the compiled schemas and the compiled
# translations are built into place by the script that does the installing.

extension.js
prefs.js
LICENSE
stylesheet.css
stylesheet-light.css
stylesheet-dark.css
icons/hicolor/scalable/actions/wisp-symbolic.svg

lib/btrfs.js
lib/compare.js
lib/configs.js
lib/details.js
lib/dialog.js
lib/exec.js
lib/format.js
lib/icon.js
lib/keys.js
lib/packages.js
lib/privileged.js
lib/requirements.js
lib/snapper.js
lib/toast.js
lib/units.js
schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.wisp.gschema.xml
